body:
## Why `request-changes` is the operator verb whose text is *longest* — it carries a whole review — and it is the only terminal-shaped verb with no file input. `hkb help` says it plainly: > `finish|block|request-review` also take `--summary-file

` `--metadata-file

` `--reason-file

`, or > `--from-stdin` with one JSON object `request-changes` is in neither list. Hit for real on 2026-09-03 sending a 15-finding review back to #315: `hkb request-changes 315 --reason-file

` answers `hkb: a reason is required`, so the reason has to travel as a positional argument. A worker cannot type that — CLAUDE.md already records that Claude Code's worktree sessions refuse heredocs, and a multi-paragraph positional with backticks and `$` in it is exactly what a harness vetting the command line word by word rejects. The operator seat hit it from a plain interactive shell too and had to spawn `bin/hkb.js` from a `.mjs` with a literal argv array. Value 4: a rung that is *possible* but tedious is a gap to close, not a workflow to document. ## What 1. `request-changes ` accepts `--reason-file

` and `--from-stdin` (the `{reason}` key of the same one-object shape the other verbs read), with the positional still working. 2. The reason becomes optional *only* when one of those supplies it — an empty reason stays exit 2 with the message it has now. 3. `hkb help` moves `request-changes` into the same sentence as the other three rather than leaving it on the line above. 4. Check the same gap on any other verb that takes free text: `hkb comment`, `hkb create --body`, `hkb edit --goal`. `create` in particular has the same problem for anything longer than a line, and filing a decomposed card body is the single most common long-text write on the board. ## Done when - [ ] `hkb request-changes --reason-file

` and `... --from-stdin` both land the reason. - [ ] A test per input path, plus one asserting a missing reason still exits 2. - [ ] Every free-text verb takes a file or stdin, or this card says in one line which does not and why. - [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green.
title: request-changes is the only free-text verb with no --reason-file, so a review has to travel as a positional
